subject: Compliance artifacts & evidence vault access for pilot evaluation
messages:
From: Rachel Kim <rachel.kim@redwood.com>
To: Tom Ellis <tom.ellis@clearframe.com>
Cc: Ben Carter <ben.carter@redwood.com>, Monica Patel <monica.patel@redwood.com>
Date: Tue, 15 Jun 2027 16:02:00 -0700
Subject: Compliance artifacts & evidence vault access for pilot evaluation

Hi Tom — thanks again for the product walkthrough this morning. Quick recap and the minimum we need to move the pilot into a security review: 

1) SOC 2 Type II report (most recent period) OR an attestation/bridge letter if the Type II is not yet released
2) Access to your evidence/trust vault (or SFTP) so our security team can fetch artifact samples (policy docs, encryption config, change logs)
3) A completed vendor security questionnaire (we can share a short XLSX) and any network diagram you can provide

Next steps I propose: I can send a short request form you can attach to the portal invite (SOC2_TypeII_Request_Form.pdf attached) and our security ops will schedule a 30-min intake once we have portal access. If you prefer, you can email artifacts directly to security@redwood.com but portal access is easier for continuous review. 

Please let me know whether ClearFrame can: 1) provide the Type II report or a bridge letter, and 2) provision a read-only account to your evidence vault (or send an invite link). If you'd like, Ben will coordinate the intake call.

Thanks —
Rachel Kim
Enterprise AE, Redwood Inference
rachel.kim@redwood.com | (415) 555-0187

Attachment: SOC2_TypeII_Request_Form.pdf

From: Tom Ellis <tom.ellis@clearframe.com>
To: Rachel Kim <rachel.kim@redwood.com>
Cc: ClearFrame Security <security@clearframe.com>
Date: Tue, 15 Jun 2027 16:28:00 -0700
Subject: Re: Compliance artifacts & evidence vault access for pilot evaluation

Hi Rachel — great to meet earlier. Quick answers: 

- We have a SOC 2 Type II report; it's scheduled for release next month but we can issue a bridge letter for the interim.
- We can provision read-only access to our evidence vault (we use TrustVault) — I’ll need the email to grant and a short list of what artifacts you need.
- I’ve attached the initial security questionnaire filled out by our security lead; it’s incomplete on a couple network diagram items.

Questions for you: what exact folder structure or file names should we surface in the vault for your reviewers? Also, who should I invite to the vault? The intake call window this week is tight — could we do next Tue (23rd) at 10am PT?

Thanks,
Tom Ellis
Director, IT & Security | ClearFrame Health
Tom.Ellis@clearframe.com | (212) 555-0122

Attachment: ClearFrame_Security_Questionnaire.xlsx

From: Rachel Kim <rachel.kim@redwood.com>
To: Tom Ellis <tom.ellis@clearframe.com>
Cc: Ben Carter <ben.carter@redwood.com>, Monica Patel <monica.patel@redwood.com>
Date: Tue, 15 Jun 2027 17:05:00 -0700
Subject: Re: Compliance artifacts & evidence vault access for pilot evaluation

Thanks Tom — exactly what we need. Short replies and next steps: 

- Bridge letter is fine for now; we’ll mark the request as "pending Type II" in our intake. Please use the attached bridge_letter_template.docx to save you time.
- Invite these accounts to the evidence vault with read-only permissions: rachel.kim@redwood.com, ben.carter@redwood.com, security@redwood.com. We only need policy docs, the SOC report/bridge, encryption key management doc, change management logs for the last 3 months, and the network diagram. If it's easier, a top-level "SOC2" folder with those subfolders is perfect.
- Intake call: Tue 23 Jun 2027 at 10:00 AM PT works for us — Ben will lead the 30-min session. 

I’ve attached the SOC2 request form for your records. Once you add our accounts to the vault, please reply with the invite link and any temporary credentials. If you prefer the portal invite, include "trust.redwood.com/invite/clearframe-2027" as a reference so our security team recognizes it in their toolchain.

Best,
Rachel

Attachments: SOC2_TypeII_Request_Form.pdf, bridge_letter_template.docx
